title: 3 Order Block Mistakes Killing Your Funded Account (2026)
description: Stop losing on funded accounts. R2F Trading breaks down the 3 order block mistakes that wipe traders out — and exactly how to fix them. Follow for daily ICT setups. r2ftrading.com
script: 3 order block mistakes. Blowing funded accounts in 2026. Most traders never catch them. Mistake one. Trading EVERY order block you see. Not all order blocks are equal. Only the ones with a liquidity sweep before them matter. No sweep? No trade. That's the rule. 78% of retail losses happen at unvalidated order blocks. Mistake two. Ignoring the fair value gap INSIDE the order block. That gap is where price actually wants to go. Mistake three. Entering on the first candle touch. Smart money runs your stop first. Wait for the SECOND touch. The R2F Trading system calls this the sweep, fill, and confirm entry. Three filters. One clean trade. Fix all three of these and your funded account stops bleeding. It really is that simple. Follow R2F Trading. New ICT setups every single day. Link in bio at r2ftrading.com.
